text: This report recommends increasing the project budget for the Community Conservation Campus Project (Front Entrance and Welcome Area Project).

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved an increase in the construction budget for the Community Conservation Campus from $28 million construction plus soft costs to $41.3 million inclusive of soft costs with the understanding that the additional budget will be supported through the existing 10-year capital plan, the Toronto Zoo Wildlife Conservancy and external funding partners. 2. Adopted the recommendation in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 30, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, and 3 to the report (March 30, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo, remain confidential until negotiations are complete, as they pertain to a plan to be applied to negotiations to be carried out on behalf of the Toronto Zoo.
